description: Reports whether stem separation is available right now (GET /stem-tool/capabilities), the models this account may use ("fast" and "quality"), the file formats ("mp3", "flac"), the maximum duration and upload size, how long results are kept, and the remaining quota with its reset time (`quota.fast` and `quota.quality`, `resetsAt` in epoch milliseconds, UTC). Call it before jj_stems_separate. Costs no quota (only the read rate limit, 240 per minute). An API key must belong to a Premium account.
name: jj_stems_capabilities
title: Stem separation: availability, limits and quota
